method: Eight batches reviewed by five gpt-5.6-luna subagents; parent adjudication before applying. Reports with incorrect actor, trigger frequency, target scope, state/event terminology, edition substitution, or field locations were corrected/rejected.

corrections.before: Play Phase: use this card on one or two characters. Each target is placed into the Chained state or Reset.
corrections.after: Play Phase: use this card on one or two characters. Each target is Turned sideways or Reset (a target Turned sideways is in the Chained state).
corrections.reason: 横置 is the operation Turn sideways; the draft instead treats it as placement into a state and loses the required action distinction.

corrections.before: Counter-clockwise from the card's user.
corrections.after: Resolve them in counter-clockwise order starting from the card's user.
corrections.reason: 结算顺序 means resolution order, not elimination order; the answer must state that the deaths are resolved in that order.

corrections.before: Twice per Play Phase: Choose a character without a 「Five Spirits」 token and assign them the Five Animals Exercise in your chosen order. The character gains the current active effect and switches to the next during their Preparation Phase. Tiger: if your card targets only one character, damage dealt +1. Crane: when the 「Crane」 character gains a 「Crane」 token, draw 3 cards. Bear: once per turn, damage you take -1. Ape: when the 「Ape」 character gains an 「Ape」 token, take 1 equipment from another character. Deer: when you gain a 「Deer」 token, recover 1 HP and remove all cards from your Judgment Zone; you cannot be targeted by Delayed Tool Cards.
corrections.after: Twice per Play Phase: Choose a character without a 「Five Spirits」 token and assign them the Five Animals Exercise in your chosen order. The character gains the current active effect and switches to the next during their Preparation Phase. Tiger: if your card targets only one character, damage dealt +1. Crane: when the 「Crane」 character gains a 「Crane」 token, draw 3 cards. Bear: once per turn, damage you take -1. Ape: when the 「Ape」 character gains an 「Ape」 token, take 1 equipment from another character. Deer: when you gain a 「Deer」 token, recover 1 HP and remove all cards from your Judgment Zone; you cannot be targeted by Time-Delayed Tool Cards.
corrections.reason: 延时锦囊 is the fixed term Time-Delayed Tool Card; Delayed Tool Card drops the required card classification.

corrections.before: Yes. [Eight Trigrams Formation] is armor. While Nullified by [Qing Gang Sword], the target cannot use its Judgment to produce a [Dodge].
corrections.after: Yes. [Eight Trigrams Formation] is treated as armor. While Nullified by [Qing Gang Sword], the target cannot use its Judgment as a [Dodge].
corrections.reason: 当【闪】使用 means Use as a [Dodge], not produce a [Dodge]; the answer also should preserve 视为 as is treated as.

corrections.before: Play Phase: use this card on a Wounded character. That character recovers 1 HP, then may discard a [Poison] from their hand to prevent that [Poison]'s effect.
corrections.after: Play Phase: use this card on a Wounded character. That character recovers 1 HP, then may discard a [Poison] to prevent that [Poison]'s effect.
corrections.reason: 弃置一张【毒】 does not specify 从手牌; adding from their hand invents a zone restriction absent from the Chinese clause.

corrections.before: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. Once per other character each Play Phase, you may have a character within your Attack Range give you one card. Yang: cancel the next damage you would deal to them this phase. Yin: after you next damage them this phase, you may deal 1 damage each, in order, to up to three different other characters.
corrections.after: Conversion Skill. At game start, you may switch this skill's state. Once per other character each Play Phase, you may have a character within your Attack Range give you one card. Yang: Remove the next damage you would deal to them this phase. Yin: after you next deal damage to them this phase, you may deal 1 damage, in order, to up to three different other characters other than them.
corrections.reason: 游戏开始时可以转换此技能状态 permits switching the state then, not selecting an initial state. The Yin target set excludes the character already damaged (除其外); the draft omits that exclusion.

corrections.before: When a character with Virtue Takes normal damage, all other characters with Virtue simultaneously choose whether to cancel it. If anyone agrees, cancel the damage. Among those who agreed, the character with the highest HP Value Loses HP equal to that damage, resolving in order if tied.
corrections.after: When a character with Virtue Takes normal damage, all other characters with Virtue simultaneously choose whether to Remove that damage. If anyone chooses yes, Remove that damage. Among the characters who chose yes, the one with the highest HP Value then Loses HP equal to the damage value.
corrections.reason: The Chinese chooses one highest-HP agreeing character; it does not specify a tie-order rule. The draft invents resolving in order if tied.

corrections.before: Your normal [Kill] may be used as a Fire [Kill]; if that Fire [Kill] deals damage, you must discard 1 card or lose 1 HP. Your [Fire Kill] may designate 1 additional target.
corrections.after: Your non-Fire [Kill] may be used as a Fire [Kill]; if that Fire [Kill] deals damage, you must discard 1 card or lose 1 HP. Your [Fire Kill] may designate 1 additional target.
corrections.reason: 非火【杀】 means any non-Fire [Kill], which includes other elemental/non-elemental variants; normal [Kill] is narrower and unsupported.

corrections.before: During your Play Phase, remove 2 「Fury」 tokens and choose a character. This turn you gain 〖Peerless〗 and their equipped armor becomes ineffective.
corrections.after: During your Play Phase, remove 2 「Fury」 tokens and choose another character. This turn you gain 〖Peerless〗 and their equipped armor is Nullified.
corrections.reason: 其防具失效 requires armor to be Nullified, the fixed term for 无效; 选择一名其他角色 also requires the target to be another character.

corrections.before: Compulsory. When you declare Slash, hide its targets from other characters and have other characters within your Attack Range choose in order whether to Play a red Basic Card. After all choices, targets who did not Play one cannot Use or Play hand cards this turn. If any non-target Played one, draw two cards and increase your Slash limit this phase by 1.
corrections.after: Compulsory. When you declare [Kill], hide its targets from other characters and have other characters within your Attack Range choose in order whether to Play a red Basic Card. After all choices, targets who did not Play one cannot Use or Play hand cards this turn. If any non-target Played one, draw two cards and increase your [Kill] usage limit this phase by 1.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 is the app card name Kill; the draft uses the legacy Slash label in both the card declaration and limit.

corrections.before: When the first Basic Card of a turn is Used, you may Recast one card. If both cards are damage cards or both are non-damage cards, that Basic Card resolves one additional time. If the Recast card is a Tool Card, add one name to Honor the Worthy: Steal, Dismantle, or Iron Chain. Once all are added, Honor the Worthy may also activate during your Preparation Phase.
corrections.after: When the first Basic Card of a turn is Used, you may Recast one card. If both cards are damage cards or both are non-damage cards, that Basic Card resolves one additional time. If the Recast card is a Tool Card, add one name to Honor the Worthy: Steal, Dismantle, or Iron Shackles. Once all are added, Honor the Worthy may also activate during your Preparation Phase.
corrections.reason: 【铁索连环】 is the canonical card name Iron Shackles; Iron Chain is not the project label.

corrections.before: After your Slash damages another character, you may gain cards from their zones up to the damage amount; they draw that many. If the cards gained between you include all three types, they choose: you are treated as Using Duel on a different character they select; or they gain Peerless until their turn ends.
corrections.after: After your [Kill] damages another character, you may gain cards from their zones up to the damage amount; they draw that many. If the cards gained between you include all three types, they choose: you are treated as Using Duel on a different character they select; or they gain Peerless until their turn ends.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 must use the app label [Kill], not Slash.

corrections.before: Once per Play Phase, you may Pindian with another character. If you win, cards you Use on them this turn have no usage or distance limits and Ignore their armor. Otherwise, you cannot Use Slash this turn. If the Pindian card you lose this way is Slash, your Slashes do not count toward this turn's Hand Limit.
corrections.after: Once per Play Phase, you may Pindian with another character. If you win, cards you Use on them this turn have no usage or distance limits and Ignore their armor. Otherwise, you cannot Use [Kill] this turn. If the Pindian card you lose this way is [Kill], your [Kill] cards do not count toward this turn's Hand Limit.
corrections.reason: Each 【杀】 occurrence is translated as the legacy Slash label; the source is the Kill card.

corrections.before: Once per Play Phase, you may hold a Strategy Contest with another character. If you win with Siege and Starve, Use the top card as Supply Shortage on them if their Judgment Zone lacks one; otherwise gain one of their cards. If you win with Beat the Drums, you are treated as Using Duel on them.
corrections.after: Once per Play Phase, you may hold a Strategy Contest with another character. If you win with Siege and Starve, Use the top card as Starvation on them if their Judgment Zone lacks one; otherwise gain one of their cards. If you win with Beat the Drums, you are treated as Using Duel on them.
corrections.reason: 【兵粮寸断】 has the canonical app name Starvation, not Supply Shortage.

corrections.before: Conversion Skill: Once per Play Phase: Yang — you may draw 1 card, then discard 2 hand cards. Yin — you may draw 2 cards, then discard 1 hand card. If you do, until the end of this turn, cards you use that share a suit with a card you discarded this way have no Distance or count restriction.
corrections.after: Conversion Skill: Once per Play Phase: Yang — you may draw 1 card, then discard 2 hand cards. Yin — you may draw 2 cards, then discard 1 hand card. If you do, until the end of this turn, cards you use that share a suit with a card you discarded this way have no Distance or usage restriction.
corrections.reason: 次数限制 in the Chinese clause is a usage restriction; “count restriction” is not the project’s rules term and can be read as a different count mechanic.

corrections.before: Compulsory. After you target a character with Slash, if you are outside their Attack Range, its damage increases by 1 and it Ignores their armor. If resolving that Slash's damage causes them to enter a Dying Event, they cannot Use Peach until that event finishes.
corrections.after: Compulsory. After you target a character with [Kill], if you are outside their Attack Range, its damage increases by 1 and it Ignores their armor. If they enter the Verge of Death State from taking damage while resolving that [Kill], they cannot Use [Peach] until that Dying Event finishes resolving.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 is [Kill]. The source distinguishes entering 濒死状态 from the subsequent 濒死事件; the draft calls the state an event and omits that the character takes the damage.

corrections.before: Locked Skill: Your multi-target Tool Cards are treated as colourless [Kill]. Your colourless cards have no Distance or usage restriction and may target any number of additional characters; each use also modifies 〖Divine Tribunal〗's activation limit (+1 each time, max 5).
corrections.after: Locked Skill: Your multi-target Tool Cards are treated as colourless [Kill]. Your colourless cards have no Distance or usage limit and may target any number of additional characters; each use also modifies 〖Divine Tribunal〗's activation limit (+1 each time, max 5).
corrections.reason: 无距离和次数限制 means no Distance and no usage limit; “usage restriction” weakens the specific limit wording.

corrections.before: When a character Uses Slash or a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, if your hand contains cards with that name, Show them and mark them as Divine Lord cards. At the end of this phase, you may Use cards equal in number to your Divine Lord cards as one of their names.
corrections.after: When a character Uses [Kill] or a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, if your hand contains cards with that name, Show them and mark them as Divine Lord cards. At the end of this phase, you may Use cards equal in number to your Divine Lord cards as one of their names.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 is the app card name [Kill], not Slash.

corrections.before: Locked Skill: During other characters' Preparation Phase, if they are Wounded, they must discard 2 cards or receive 1 normal damage. Until the end of their turn, they cannot retain black hand cards.
corrections.after: Locked Skill: During other characters' Preparation Phase, if they are Wounded, they must discard 2 cards or Take 1 normal damage. Until the end of their turn, they cannot retain black hand cards.
corrections.reason: 受到1点普通伤害 is Take 1 normal damage; “receive” loses the project’s Take damage operation label.

corrections.before: Locked Skill: At the end of your Play Phase, draw cards until you reach your Hand Limit (up to a maximum of 5 cards drawn). When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.
corrections.after: Locked Skill: At the end of your Play Phase, draw cards until you reach your Hand Limit (up to 5 hand cards). When this card leaves your Equipment Zone, it is instead Removed from the Game.
corrections.reason: 至多摸至五张 caps the resulting hand at five cards, not the number of cards drawn.

corrections.before: Once per card name: when you become the target of a Tool Card, record that card name and negate its effect on you. At the start of your turn, you may add or remove one Tool Card name from your Grand Pacification record.
corrections.after: Once per card name: when you become the target of a Tool Card, record that card name and Remove you as a target from it. At the start of your turn, you may add or remove one Tool Card name from your Grand Pacification record.
corrections.reason: 取消之 is the canonical Remove target operation, not Nullify/negate; the source says to remove your target from that Tool Card.

corrections.before: Each card name once per turn. After you Use Slash or Duel on a sole target, you may increase its Base Damage Value by 1. If it deals no damage, you may have the target be treated as Using Slash on you.
corrections.after: Once per card name per turn, after you Use [Kill] or [Duel] on a sole target, you may increase its Base Damage Value by 1. If it deals no damage, you may have the target be treated as Using [Kill] on you.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 must be [Kill]; the revised opening states the per-card-name limit explicitly while preserving each card name’s once-per-turn condition.

corrections.before: Compulsory. At the end of another character's turn, if exactly one character Took damage this turn, have that character choose: Use a Slash that entered the discard pile this turn; or Lose 1 HP.
corrections.after: Compulsory. At the end of another character's turn, if exactly one character Took damage this turn, have that character choose: Use a [Kill] that entered the discard pile this turn; or Lose 1 HP.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 is the app card name [Kill], not Slash.

corrections.before: Once per Play Phase: If the character who granted you this skill is alive and has a Max HP greater than 1, you may reduce their Max HP by 1 and treat it as using a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card.
corrections.after: Once per Play Phase: If the character who granted you this skill is alive and has a Max HP greater than 1, you may reduce their Max HP by 1 and be treated as using a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card.
corrections.reason: 视为使用 applies to you (the character), not an unspecified “it”; the revised wording preserves the treated-as operation.

corrections.before: Lord Skill: When you need to use or play a [Kill], you may have other Shu faction characters each choose whether to play a [Kill] on your behalf (treated as used or played by you).
corrections.after: Lord Skill: When you need to Use or Play a [Kill], you may have other Shu faction characters each choose whether to Play a [Kill] (treated as Used or Played by you).
corrections.reason: 使用 and 打出 are distinct canonical operations Use and Play; the source explicitly says the chosen card is treated as Used or Played by you.

corrections.before: When a character whose Attack Range includes you becomes a target of Slash, if you are neither its user nor a target, they may discard one card to transfer that Slash to you.
corrections.after: When a character whose Attack Range includes you becomes a target of [Kill], if you are neither its user nor a target, they may discard one card to transfer that [Kill] to you.
corrections.reason: 【杀】 must be translated as [Kill], not Slash.

corrections.before: Zhang Jue has final control. 〖Geomancy〗 operates before the Judgment Card is flipped by presetting the top of the Draw Pile, while 〖Ghost Path〗 operates after the Judgment Card is flipped by substituting it. Since substitution resolves later than presetting, Zhang Jue can replace the card Guo Tiying has preset.
corrections.after: Zhang Jue has final control. 〖Geomancy〗 operates before the Judgment Card is Revealed by presetting the top of the Draw Pile, while 〖Ghost Path〗 operates after the Judgment Card is Revealed by substituting it. Since substitution resolves later than presetting, Zhang Jue can replace the card Guo Tiying has preset.
corrections.reason: 亮出 is the canonical Reveal operation; “flipped” collapses it into 翻面/face-up language.

corrections.before: At the start of your Play Phase, you may draw two cards. If you do, during this phase, after a character loses all their Endure Hardship cards or their last hand card, if nobody is in a Dying Event, have one character perform an option: discard two cards; draw two cards; Recast all Equipment Cards; or place a Tool Card on top of the deck or Lose 1 HP. Each option may be chosen once per turn.
corrections.after: At the start of your Play Phase, you may draw two cards. If you do, during this phase, after a character loses all their Endure Hardship cards or their last hand card, if nobody is in the Verge of Death State, have one character perform an option: discard two cards; draw two cards; Recast all Equipment Cards; or place a Tool Card on top of the deck or Lose 1 HP. Each option may be chosen once per turn.
corrections.reason: 濒死状态 denotes the Verge of Death State; Dying Event is the separate 濒死事件 term.

corrections.before: Can the target discard equipment or time-delay Tool Cards when resolving [Twin Swords]?
corrections.after: Can the target discard cards in their Equipment Zone or Time-Delayed Tool Cards in their Judgment Zone when resolving [Twin Swords]?
corrections.reason: 装备区的牌 and 判定区的延时锦囊牌 specify the zones and the canonical Time-Delayed Tool Card term.

corrections.before: During your Play Phase, you may place [Sentinel Mirror] from your hand into another character's Equipment Zone. When you take damage that would reduce your HP to 0 or below, or damage exceeding 1, you may place [Sentinel Mirror] from any Equipment Zone into the Discard Pile to prevent that damage.
corrections.after: During your Play Phase, you may place [Sentinel Mirror] from your hand into another character's Equipment Zone. When you take damage that would reduce your HP to 0 or below, or damage exceeding 1, you may place [Sentinel Mirror] from your Equipment Zone into the Discard Pile to prevent that damage.
corrections.reason: Chinese says 将装备区里的【护心镜】置入弃牌堆 in the effect that prevents your damage; it does not authorize taking a Sentinel Mirror from any character's Equipment Zone. “from any Equipment Zone” broadens the legal source.

corrections.before: During your End Phase, you may choose one character with less HP than you, or all other characters with Supply Shortage in their Judgment Zones. Each chooses: give you one hand card; or take 1 damage. After all choices, you may give any cards gained this way to one other character.
corrections.after: During your End Phase, you may choose one character with less HP than you, or all other characters with Starvation in their Judgment Zones. Each chooses: give you one hand card; or take 1 damage. After all choices, you may give any cards gained this way to one other character.
corrections.reason: 兵粮寸断 is the app card name Starvation; Supply Shortage is not the canonical card label.

corrections.before: During your Play Phase, you may Recast a club hand card. Once per Play Phase, you may Use a club hand card as Iron Chain. When you Use Iron Chain, you may add any number of targets. After it designates its first target, randomly discard one hand card from every target not already Chained.
corrections.after: During your Play Phase, you may Recast a club hand card. Once per Play Phase, you may Use a club hand card as Iron Shackles. When you Use Iron Shackles, you may add any number of targets. After it designates its first target, randomly discard one hand card from every target not already Chained.
corrections.reason: 铁索连环 must use the app card name Iron Shackles; Iron Chain is an unapproved alias.

corrections.before: Compulsory. After a character Takes fire damage, your next Fire Slash or Fire Attack may have one extra target; this does not stack. Your Fire Slashes and Fire Attacks deal X additional damage, where X is the number of factions present.
corrections.after: Compulsory. After a character takes fire damage, your next Fire [Kill] or Incendiary may have one extra target; this does not stack. Your Fire [Kill] cards and Incendiaries deal X additional damage, where X is the number of factions present.
corrections.reason: 火【杀】 must use the app Kill label, and 火攻 is the canonical card name Incendiary; Fire Slash/Fire Attack are unsupported aliases.

corrections.before: Four times per Play Phase, you may Use a diamond card as Indulgence or discard an Indulgence on the field, then draw one card.
corrections.after: Four times per Play Phase, you may Use a diamond card as Acedia or discard an Acedia on the field, then draw one card.
corrections.reason: 乐不思蜀 is the canonical app card name Acedia, not Indulgence.

corrections.before: Once per Play Phase, you may have another character choose a suit, then gain and show 1 of your hand cards. If that card has a different suit from the one they chose, deal 1 damage to them.
corrections.after: Once per Play Phase, you may have another character choose a suit, then have them gain and Show 1 of your hand cards. If that card has a different suit from the one they chose, deal 1 damage to them.

corrections.before: During your Play Phase, you may remove 1 「Glory」 token, then discard 1 card on the field.
corrections.after: During your Play Phase, you may remove 1 「Glory」 card, then discard 1 card on the field.

corrections.before: Compulsory. At the start of your Play Phase, choose up to X hand cards of different suits and randomly give them to that many unrecorded other characters, where X is the number of such characters. Each recipient chooses in order: Use Slash on you and become recorded; or give you one card, then you draw one card. If all choose the same option, you may have an unrecorded character be treated as Using Slash.
corrections.after: Compulsory. At the start of your Play Phase, choose up to X hand cards of different suits and randomly give them to that many unrecorded other characters, where X is the number of such characters. Each recipient chooses in order: Use a [Kill] on you and become recorded; or give you one card, then you draw one card. If all choose the same option, you may have an unrecorded character be treated as Using a [Kill].
corrections.reason: The source names 【杀】; app card terminology requires [Kill], not the generic Slash alias.

corrections.before: Charge (2/4). At the start of each round, spend any amount of Charge and choose: reduce your Distance to others by 1 this round and select X Slashes from the deck; or increase others' Distance to you by 1 this round and select X Dodges. X is Charge spent. Place selected cards on your General Card as Guards, up to four. You may Use or Play Guards as though they were hand cards.
corrections.after: Charge (2/4). At the start of each round, spend any amount of Charge and choose: reduce your Distance to others by 1 this round and select X [Kill] cards from the deck; or increase others' Distance to you by 1 this round and select X [Dodge] cards. X is Charge spent. Place selected cards on your General Card as Guards, up to four. You may Use or Play Guards as though they were hand cards.
corrections.reason: The source explicitly names 【杀】 and 【闪】; app card labels are [Kill] and [Dodge], not Slashes/Dodges.

corrections.reason: 将...当作【杀】 uses the app card name [Kill], not Slash.

corrections.before: After you Use Slash, you may give that Slash and the Dodge cards Used by its targets to a different character. If the cards they gain include red cards, they may Use a Slash on a character within your Attack Range. If they include black cards, they draw one card.

corrections.reason: Every reference is to 【杀】/【闪】; use [Kill]/[Dodge] consistently.

corrections.before: Compulsory. After you Lose each 1 HP, draw three cards. If it is your Play Phase, increase your Slash limit by 1 this turn; red Slashes you Use this turn have no distance limit and cannot be responded to with Dodge.

corrections.after: Compulsory. When a character damages you with a [Kill], if it is red, they recover 1 HP or draw one card. Otherwise, you draw one card.
